live.title: Live View
live.webrtcHint: Enable RTSP main + WebRTC in streaming settings for low-latency view:

schedule.errTimeRange: End time must be after start time

storage.sdSectionDesc: Configure LAN sharing and the recording write mode for the SD card.
storage.nasSectionDesc: Connection info for a NAS (SMB/CIFS share) used as a recording/timelapse destination. Used when "Save to NAS" is enabled in each recording setting.
storage.eraseConfirmBody: Deletes the recording folders (continuous and alarm) on the SD card. This cannot be undone.

hub.integrationsDesc: Pick the service you want to use — we take care of the required stream settings.

frigate.desc: AI-detection NVR. Connects with the officially recommended two-stream setup: detect on the sub stream, record on the main stream.
frigate.hint: Paste this example into Frigate's config.yml.

ha.desc: Bring the live view in via the go2rtc add-on or the Generic Camera integration.

youtube.title: Live streaming (YouTube Live etc.)
youtube.desc: Stream the camera directly to any RTMP-capable platform.
youtube.autoNote: Saving automatically enables the main stream with AAC audio. Enter the platform's RTMP URL + stream key.

homekit.title: Apple Home (HomeKit)
homekit.desc: Add the camera to the Home app on iPhone / iPad / Mac.
homekit.pinAfterSave: A PIN is generated on save and shown here.
homekit.steps: Home app → Add Accessory → "More options…" and enter this PIN.

hub.streamsDesc: The RTSP streams that power the integrations. Copy a URL or hand it to a player (VLC etc.) via QR code.
hub.subHint: Low resolution (360p). Ideal for AI detection (Frigate's detect role) and mobile viewing.
hub.memWarn: Enabling multiple streams together with WebRTC/live streaming approaches the memory limit (measured: 61/87MB with RTSP+WebRTC). Turn off what you don't use.
hub.hevcNote: HEVC (H.265) saves bandwidth but has limited player support and uses more memory. The main H.264 stream is recommended for most setups.

guide.step1: Open the site's dashboard via "Get stream key" below and copy your stream key
guide.step3: After saving, streaming starts within a minute. Check the preview on the streaming site

youtube.desc: The world's largest video site. Unlisted streams work well for family monitoring
youtube.note: Channels enabling live streaming for the first time may need up to 24 hours of activation on YouTube's side

twitch.desc: A popular live streaming platform for gaming
twitch.note: Transcoding (quality options) may not always be available depending on streamer status

niconico.desc: A Japanese live streaming service (Nico Nico Live)
niconico.step2: Join the URL (rtmp://…) and stream key shown in the broadcast page's settings with "/" and paste it into the RTMP card's URL
niconico.note: The URL and key change per broadcast — paste them again each time. A premium account may be required

facebook.desc: Facebook Live. You can limit the audience to friends
facebook.note: Note the rtmps:// (encrypted) URL. A new stream key is issued for each broadcast

guide.step2b: A template is already in the "Stream URL" field below. Replace YOUR_STREAM_KEY with the key you copied

live.title: Live streaming
live.desc: Stream the camera to YouTube, Twitch and others. Pick a destination to see its steps.

vlc.title: Watch in VLC / phone
vlc.desc: Watch the camera directly in VLC or a phone video player.
vlc.hint: Scan the QR with VLC on your phone, or open the URL.

camera.holdToCompare: Click to toggle between the previous and current look (takes 1–2 s)

events.webhookDesc: POSTs a JSON payload to any server when an event occurs.
events.presetsNote: ntfy works as-is with this URL format. Discord / Slack webhook URLs are detected automatically and the payload is converted to each service's format.
events.mqttDesc: Integrate with Home Assistant etc. via an MQTT broker.
events.mqttDiscovery: Saving with MQTT enabled sends Home Assistant MQTT Discovery config so a sensor is added automatically.
events.eventsDesc: Choose which events trigger a notification. Sent to both WebHook and MQTT.
events.needTarget: Set a WebHook URL or MQTT first
events.failHint4xx: The endpoint rejected the request body. Check the URL and format
events.failHintTimeout: Could not reach the endpoint. Check the URL, network and DNS

ts.desc: Set up a VPN (Tailscale) to reach the camera securely from other networks.
ts.statusDesc: State on your tailnet and where to reach it.
ts.notConnected: Not connected. Enter an auth key and save to connect.
ts.integrationsDesc: Settings to use the camera securely from outside over the tailnet.

frigate.desc: Let a Frigate on another network pull securely via RTSP over the tailnet.
frigate.hint: Paste this example into Frigate's config.yml.

acl.title: Access control (ACL)
acl.desc: Fine-grained firewall that limits ports per tag.
acl.hint: Paste this template into the policy editor in the admin console and adjust as needed.

warn.title: This change may disconnect you or lock you out
warn.viaTailnet: You are viewing this page via Tailscale. If applying fails, this page itself may become unreachable. Note the LAN URL (http://<LAN IP>/) before saving.
warn.tags: Tag change: reconnection fails if the new tag is not allowed in the ACL tagOwners or the auth key cannot grant it. Verify in the admin console before saving.
warn.hostname: Hostname change: the MagicDNS name changes, so the previous URL will stop working.
warn.authKey: Auth key change: reconnection fails if the key is invalid or expired.
warn.disable: Disabling: all access via Tailscale will be cut off.
warn.exitNodeOnly: Tailscale-only mode: LAN ports (80/8080/8554) will be closed. If Tailscale fails, this WebUI becomes unreachable from the LAN too.

ts.applying: Applying Tailscale settings (up to 60s). The connection may drop temporarily.
ts.applyFailed: Failed to send the apply command. Settings will take effect on next boot.
ts.restarting: Restarting tailscaled. It may take up to a minute to come back.

trial.title: Is the connection still working?
trial.body: Tailscale settings were applied. If you can see and use this screen, press "Keep settings". If you don't confirm, the previous settings will be restored automatically for safety.
trial.countdown: Reverting to the previous settings in {{s}}s
trial.reverting: Restoring the previous settings. Reconnection may take up to a minute
trial.revertedBody: No confirmation arrived in time, so the previous settings were restored and the connection re-established. This fail-safe prevents lockouts.
trial.revertedNotice: No confirmation received — settings were restored automatically

ts.checkingHint: Checking the status. Right after applying, it can take 1–2 minutes to settle.
ts.stoppedHint: Not connected. Check "Last error" below or restart tailscaled.
ts.exitNodeNeedTailnet: Turning this on closes LAN-side access. To avoid locking yourself out, reopen this WebUI via the tailnet (http://<host>.ts.net/ or 100.x.x.x) first, then change it

auth.title: WebUI login
auth.desc: Ask for a username and password when opening this screen.
auth.warnBody: Without a login, anyone on the same network can open these settings and read your Tailscale auth key and NAS/RTSP passwords. Set a password.
auth.hint: Your browser will ask for these credentials. If you forget the password, remove the DIGEST line from hack.ini on the SD card.
auth.enabled: WebUI login enabled — credentials are required from the next visit
auth.gateBody: This camera stores your Tailscale auth key and other passwords. To keep them private, the rest of the UI is unavailable until a login is configured.
auth.descAdmin: The username is fixed to admin. Set a password.
